package.name: kin5axcam
package.description: A 3D Surface (5axis) operation for the CAM workbench: a zigzag over the parameter space of one face, cut with any shape of tool. The path carries the tip of the tool, worked out from the roundness at the end of it. The orientation of the tool, and with it the five-axis output that feeds the kin5ax postprocessor, follows in the next versions.

workbench.description: Adds the command CAM_Surface5Axis to the CAM workbench. It is not a workbench of its own.
